task69_output_contract.classification: one of VALIDATION_PASS / VALIDATION_FAIL / VALIDATION_INCONCLUSIVE (see pass_logic below)

pass_logic.principle: No single magical metric. VALIDATION_PASS requires ALL of the following collectively; do not loosen this list after seeing the actual Task 69 numbers.
VALIDATION_PASS_requires_all_of: 1. net_expectancy_primary_cost > 0 under the frozen primary_cost_bps=10.0 assumption.

2. gross effect direction consistent with discovery: gross_expectancy's sign matches the FADE direction (i.e. trades taken in the fade direction show a positive gross edge on average, not merely a positive net after unusual cost assumptions).
3. no one-symbol or one-day domination: top1_symbol_contribution <= 0.40 AND top1_day_contribution <= 0.40 (same 40% concentration flag threshold used throughout Task 67A/67B).

4. removing top winners does not completely destroy the result: top3_winners_removed_expectancy remains > -1x the primary net_expectancy_primary_cost magnitude (i.e. the edge is not ENTIRELY manufactured by 3 trades -- a defensible, non-arbitrary floor, not a fine-tuned cutoff).

5. enough trades/events for interpretation: number_of_trades >= 30 AND symbol_coverage >= 10 AND session_coverage >= 10 (broad-breadth bar, consistent with Task 67's SEVERELY_LIMITED thresholds, not a new invented number).

6. bootstrap uncertainty not grossly inconsistent with positive edge: bootstrap_ci's ci_low for net_expectancy_primary_cost is not deeply, obviously negative (a reasonable reading: ci_low > -1x the primary_cost_bps magnitude in return terms) -- the CI does not need to fully exclude zero to pass (a validation sample is smaller than discovery and some uncertainty is expected), but a CI that is clearly, strongly negative throughout is disqualifying.

7. realistic costs do not erase essentially all edge: result_10bps remains positive (same as criterion 1) AND result_5bps is not dramatically better than result_10bps in a way that suggests the edge only exists at implausibly low cost assumptions.

8. no causal/data-integrity violation: strategy_fingerprint_match=true, dataset_hash recorded, zero interpolated/forward-filled/synthetic prices, all timestamps causal (Task 69 must re-run the same causality-check pattern used in Task 68A's own tests, at least spot-check style, on the validation run).
pass_logic.VALIDATION_FAIL: Evidence materially contradicts the frozen hypothesis -- e.g. net_expectancy_primary_cost is negative AND gross direction is also inconsistent with the fade hypothesis (not merely thin/inconclusive), or a clear causal/data-integrity violation is found.
pass_logic.VALIDATION_INCONCLUSIVE: Sample size or uncertainty prevents a credible decision either way -- e.g. number_of_trades/symbol_coverage/session_coverage fall short of criterion 5's bar, or bootstrap_ci is too wide to support either PASS or FAIL confidently. This is NOT the same as FAIL and must not be reported as one.
pass_logic.explicit_prohibition: Do not loosen, reweight, or drop any of the 8 PASS criteria after seeing the actual Task 69 validation numbers. If the frozen criteria produce an uncomfortable result, that is the result -- re-litigating the bar after the fact defeats the entire purpose of pre-registration.

replication_gate: Replication (a further, independent holdout period) is FORBIDDEN unless Task 69's classification is exactly VALIDATION_PASS. VALIDATION_FAIL or VALIDATION_INCONCLUSIVE must not be followed by a replication attempt on a different window in search of a better result -- that would be exactly the kind of post-hoc data-mining this entire research program has been structured to avoid.
